main.description: Create an instance for the caller, and start a job that follows its provisioning. Customers only.

slug.description: The instance's subdomain: 3 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per intended change and resends on every retry of it, so a retry gets the original reply instead of acting twice.

terms.description: The beta terms the caller accepted with the create form's checkbox. The provisioner refuses a create without it (TermsRequired), staff included; it is optional here only so clients can start sending it before the provisioner requires it.

jobId.description: The background job following the change. Poll it with at.happyproto.server.getJob.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: slug, plan or idempotencyKey is missing or malformed.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: it reserves slugs by configuration as well.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the instance is already changing, or a request with this idempotencyKey is still running.

errors.name: TermsRequired
errors.description: The create carried no acceptance of the beta terms, or one without its wording.

errors.name: TermsOutdated
errors.description: The accepted terms are no longer the ones in force: reload and accept the current ones.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers, or the job could not be started.

instance.description: A customer's HappyView instance. Never carries the provisioner's placement or internal fields.

versionLabel.description: The HappyView version the release carries, e.g. 3.0.0-alpha.41, when known.

availableVersion.description: A newer release, when one is on offer.

operation.description: The change in progress, if any.

error.description: The provisioner's error code, when it failed.

availableVersion.description: A newer HappyView release the instance can upgrade to.

version.description: The release to pass to at.happyproto.server.upgradeInstance.

label.description: The HappyView version the release carries, e.g. 3.0.0-alpha.41, when known.

termsAcceptance.description: An acceptance of the beta terms, recorded append-only by the provisioner with the caller's DID.

termsVersion.description: The terms in force, e.g. beta-2026-11. Anything else is TermsOutdated.

textVersion.description: The version of the checkbox's wording.

text.description: The exact wording the caller ticked.
